title: What is block caving?
summary: Block caving is a large-scale underground mining method that uses gravity to break, fragment and extract ore from deep underground deposits.
body_markdown:
## Related stories


### Oyu Tolgoi


Oyu Tolgoi, in the Umnugovi province of Mongolia, is one of the largest known copper and gold deposits in the world


### Oyu Tolgoi underground


Our world-class open pit mine and underground project using block-caving mining techniques to extract the ore and transport it to the surface.


### Decade of innovation, lifetime of opportunity


Many standout moments have helped define the first 10 years of operation at Oyu Tolgoi
